instruction: Please increase the maximum volume limit in VLC to 200 percent. I need higher volume for some quiet audio files, and the default 125% maximum is insufficient for my needs.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing VLC's maximum volume setting to 200% (qt-max-volume=200). Uses existing check_qt_max_volume metric function which verifies the VLC config file. Default value is 125, task requires changing to 200.
